g.text: ║ AST NETWORK / SIGNAL ARCHIVE / UNKNOWN ORIGIN ║
I build worlds where software, simulation,
media and story share the same signal.
AstorAST is an independent creator and developer within the AST Network, exploring digital
systems, simulation, media and fictional worlds. Interfaces behave like systems; data becomes
part of the story; every project becomes another fragment of a larger world.
An expanding network of worlds, characters, stories and
forgotten fragments. New records surface as the universe
An unidentified transmission buried in the AST Network.
Lost records, corrupted data and unknown entities point
toward a layer that should not exist.
Virtual aviation, aircraft systems, EFB interfaces and
Experimental interfaces, websites and digital environments
built to behave less like pages and more like functioning
Visual identities, motion systems, recordings and creative experiments preserved as
fragments of the wider AST ecosystem.
MADE THINGS FOR HUMAN, FOR AI, FOR EARTH
